text:
Jordan: Heads up — I'm prototyping a small change to expose rate-limit signals from the platform to clients so SDKs can surface smarter retry UX. Proposal: add an optional response header `X-RW-RLS` with a compact payload describing quota bucket + window. Example:
```
X-RW-RLS: {"b":"api-chat","l":1200,"r":340,"t":1680000000}
```
Would let SDKs show in-console/per-route quota sliders and expose an `onQuotaUpdate`/`quota_update` event to apps. Thoughts?

Priya: nice idea. what's the telemetry plan? we need a canonical metric so console/alerts don't double-count. recommend `quota.exposed.v1` with tags route=bucket+tenant.

Sam: +1 but caution re: proxies and CORS. some gateways will strip long headers. maybe offer both: compact header `X-RW-RLS-V1` with token and a platform-side telemetry event for server-side consumers.

Maya: SDK surface question — languages vary. Python/Go should provide a sync callback `on_quota_update`, TS should emit an EventEmitter event. also agree this must be opt-in via client config to avoid telemetry/space noise.

Ivy: console mapping: we can map bucket ids -> friendly names, but need migration for legacy requests with no header. also need to distinguish reserved/dedicated vs shared quotas in UI.

Jordan: rollout idea: header is opt-in per-tenant behind a policy flag; SDKs add `exposeQuotaHeader: false` default, opt-in in next minor. platform emits `quota.exposed.v1` telemetry; sampling default 1% to start. will add `quota_source` tag (dedicated|shared|fallback).

Priya: start with 1% sampling please — retention impact otherwise is huge. also include `quota_operation` tag (read/write/generation) so we can alert on specific workloads.

Sam: implementation sketch for TS client:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({exposeQuotaHeader: true});
client.on('quota_update', info => { /* info.bucket, info.remaining, info.reset */ });
```
If header missing -> no event. fallback behavior: SDKs should surface a non-blocking toast suggesting users slow down, not block by default.

Maya: PM asked whether console can toggle "SDK affordances" per org so we can A/B test new UX without changing tenant flags everywhere. Ops wants to measure error/noise delta before full rollout.

Ivy: suggest canary plan: 10 tenants (internal+partners) -> monitor infra & retention -> 50 tenants -> full. check any CDN/caching layers that might remove custom headers.

Jordan: plan accepted. I'll draft RFC with header binary-token format (very compact), telemetry tag list, sampling defaults, and SDK API surface proposals for py/ts/go. will open PR for spec + prototype server patch. pinging @eng-infra for proxy checks. thanks :thumbsup:
